payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes the 1-indexed position of a cell in the cultivation sequence by subtracting waste cells before it using per-row counts and a linear scan within the row.
payload.rationale: The solution does not sort any data; it uses prefix sums and linear membership tests. Among the provided subtypes, none match exactly, but this is the least unrelated as it operates on per-row waste lists, though no custom key sorting occurs.
